svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="zpVAPmfQ5AEQOmhTeI64" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="4995" dy="2665" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant RL as rateLimiter<br/>(middleware)
 participant Redis as Redis
 participant Ctrl as Auth Controller
 participant Svc as Auth Service
 participant Prisma as Prisma
 participant DB as PostgreSQL

 C->>+RL: POST /v1/auth/reset-password<br/>{ token, newPassword }

 RL->>+Redis: INCR rl:reset-password:per-hour:ip:<ip>
 Note over RL,Redis: Lua script — atomic<br/>INCR + EXPIRE
 Redis-->>-RL: count

 alt over 5/hour
 RL-->>C: 429 Too Many Requests<br/>Retry-After: <ttl>
 else within limits
 RL->>+Ctrl: forward request
 Ctrl->>Ctrl: validate(ResetPasswordDto)

 Ctrl->>+Svc: resetPassword(token, newPassword)

 Svc->>+Redis: GET password_reset:<token>
 Redis-->>-Svc: userId or null

 alt token not found or expired
 Svc-->>Ctrl: 400 AppError(TOKEN_INVALID)
 Ctrl-->>C: 400 Reset token is invalid or has expired
 else token valid
 Note over Svc: bcrypt hash<br/>cost factor = 12
 Svc->>Svc: hashPassword(newPassword)

 par update password
 Svc->>+Prisma: user.update({ userId }, { passwordHash })
 Prisma->>+DB: UPDATE auth.users<br/>SET password_hash = $1<br/>WHERE user_id = $2
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack
 and invalidate reset token
 Svc->>+Redis: DEL password_reset:<token>
 Note over Svc,Redis: single-use enforced —<br/>deleted immediately
 Redis-->>-Svc: ok
 and revoke all sessions
 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.updateMany(<br/>{ userId, revoked: false },<br/>{ revoked: true })
 Prisma->>+DB: UPDATE auth.refresh_tokens<br/>SET revoked = TRUE<br/>WHERE user_id = $1<br/>AND revoked = FALSE
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack
 end

 Svc->>+Prisma: auditLog.create({ userId, event: 'user.password_reset_completed' })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO auth.audit_logs (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc-->>-Ctrl: ack
 Ctrl-->>-C: 200 Password reset successfully
 end
 end
",
